note: All 52 STL implementation nodes are assigned exactly once. Canonical graph dependencies and approval gates remain authoritative.

batches.title: Control-plane alignment and baseline
batches.purpose: Make /goal, Graphify, specialists, and Graph Engineer obey one target architecture before product implementation.
tasks: Preserve/checkpoint any working-tree changes and record HEAD.
Expose goal, goal:verify, ship:eval, ship:improve, and graph:* commands when their scripts exist.
Install CURRENT_DECISIONS.md and add a deterministic stale-architecture guard.
Align AGENTS.md, .agents/STACK.md, .agents/specialists.json, generated host-native specialists, and Codex config.
Replace the absolute Graphify path with a repository/worktree-safe binding.
Install or verify Graph Engineer v2 and copy the canonical graph/ledger structure into .graph.
Run npm ci, Graphify status/fixtures, lint, test, build, and save complete baseline logs.
Use the Vercel plugin to snapshot project, deployments, runtime errors, production deployment, and rollback reference.
Use Vercel CLI to inventory Marketplace Integration resources, project links, environment scopes, and connectors without changing production.
Install package domain skills into .agents/skills, verify installed/repository skills, compile host adapters, and validate every graph node skill route.
Search current Vercel Services documentation and produce the preview topology/configuration contract for web and integrations services.
exit: Stale architecture instructions cannot silently override the approved decisions.
Baseline failures are recorded before product edits.

batches.title: Revenue and security stabilization
batches.purpose: Close confirmed lead-loss, auth, file privacy, route, webhook, and critical-journey failures.
exit: G10-STABILIZED passes with deterministic evidence and preview-safe tests.

parallelism.rule: Separate revenue and security/route worktrees with disjoint locks.

batches.title: Convex, Clerk, authorization, and migration foundation
batches.purpose: Build target identity/data foundations and complete verified legacy inventories and reconciliation tools. Implement the Vercel Services web/integrations topology and project/resource links in preview-safe form.
exit: G20-FOUNDATION-READY passes with authz, lifecycle, audit, event, idempotency, and migration evidence.
A preview deployment builds both Vercel services, service binding works, integrations service is internal except explicit rewrites, and Vercel plugin evidence is recorded.

parallelism.rule: Identity/security and data/migration paths integrate through typed contracts.

batches.title: Public site, design, CMS, SEO, and local growth
batches.purpose: Consolidate public templates, publication authority, route registry, SEO, reviews, proof, and GBP workspace.
exit: G30-PUBLIC-CMS-READY passes with crawl, accessibility, provenance, preview, and migration evidence.

parallelism.rule: Design/templates and CMS/migration use separate worktrees.

batches.title: Visitor-to-booking and revenue workflow
batches.purpose: Complete durable lead, booking, CRM, estimate, proposal, agreement, deposit, and follow-up in test/preview mode.
exit: G31-VISITOR-TO-BOOKING and G40-PROPOSAL-TO-DEPOSIT pass in preview/test mode.

parallelism.rule: Funnel/CRM and proposal/payment paths share typed domain contracts.

batches.title: Customer portal and operator cockpit
batches.purpose: Build resource-isolated portal, project operations, private files, change orders, crew assignment, automations, and health views.
exit: G50-PORTAL-OPS-READY passes with cross-customer isolation and project workflow evidence.

parallelism.rule: Portal and operator writers consume generated DTO contracts, not raw database clients.

batches.title: Measurement, cutover preparation, and rollback
batches.purpose: Reconcile attribution, migration state, canaries, rollback exports, restore evidence, and decommission readiness.
exit: G60-MEASUREMENT-READY passes and G70 has a complete approval packet.

batches.title: Separately authorized production cutover
batches.purpose: Perform only explicitly approved production actions and preserve rollback capability.
exit: Production reconciles, the monitored window clears, and legacy removal receives separate approval.
